booking_payments_kind_fields.name: booking_payments_kind_fields
booking_payments_kind_fields.value:
("booking_payments"."kind" = 'payment' and "booking_payments"."receipt_no" is not null and "booking_payments"."method_id" is not null and "booking_payments"."reversal_of_id" is null and "booking_payments"."reversal_ref" is null)
       or ("booking_payments"."kind" = 'reversal' and "booking_payments"."reversal_ref" is not null and "booking_payments"."reversal_of_id" is not null and "booking_payments"."note" is not null and "booking_payments"."receipt_no" is null)

employee_profiles_phone_complete.name: employee_profiles_phone_complete
employee_profiles_phone_complete.value: ("employee_profiles"."phone_e164" is null) = ("employee_profiles"."phone_country_code" is null) and ("employee_profiles"."phone_e164" is null) = ("employee_profiles"."phone_number" is null)

employee_profiles_identity.name: employee_profiles_identity
employee_profiles_identity.value: "employee_profiles"."user_id" is not null or ("employee_profiles"."full_name" is not null and length(btrim("employee_profiles"."full_name")) > 0)

files_owner.name: files_owner
files_owner.value: "files"."lead_id" is not null or "files"."finance_entry_id" is not null
